help.bannerSub: Frequently asked questions and contact information

faq.q: What is an HPL panel and where is it used?
faq.a: HPL (High Pressure Laminate) is a composite cladding material manufactured under high pressure. It is widely used on building exteriors, office interiors, and commercial facades. It is moisture-resistant, long-lasting, and visually appealing.

faq.q: How long does facade installation take?
faq.a: Installation time depends on the size and complexity of the building. Small buildings (up to 500 m²) typically take 2–3 weeks; large commercial projects can take 1–3 months. An exact timeline is provided after reviewing the project.

faq.q: What is the difference between granite and seranit cladding?
faq.a: Granite is a natural stone with high durability and a unique appearance, but it is heavier and more expensive. Seranit is a modern ceramic-granite composite — lighter, more affordable, and available in a wider range of colours. Both are excellent choices for facades.

faq.q: What are the advantages of LED lighting over traditional lighting?
faq.a: LED lighting consumes 70–80% less electricity, lasts up to 10 times longer (up to 50,000 hours), produces no heat, and requires minimal maintenance. This delivers significant savings over the long term.

Alikafon is an aluminium composite panel consisting of two thin aluminium sheets bonded to a polyethylene core. It is lightweight, easy to work with, modern in appearance, and resistant to weathering. It is commonly used in facades and signage structures.

faq.q: What do I need to place an order?
faq.a: To place an order, simply provide the approximate area or number of light points, the type of service (facade or lighting), and your phone number. Our specialist will contact you to clarify the details and prepare a free estimate.

All installation work comes with a minimum 2-year workmanship warranty. Material warranties for HPL panels and granite cladding can extend to 10–15 years. LED lighting systems carry a 3-year warranty.

Emergency lighting is an independent system that activates automatically during a power failure, enabling the safe evacuation of a building. It is legally mandatory for offices, shopping centres, and public buildings.
Yes, we provide free technical maintenance throughout the warranty period. After the warranty expires, a separate service agreement can be arranged at competitive rates.

faq.q: Can I find out the project cost in advance?
faq.a: Yes — after inspecting the site, our specialist will prepare a free estimate. Simply call us or fill in the order form and we will respond within 24 hours.

section.heading: About Us
section.body1: FBC Group is the leading company in Uzbekistan specialising in facade cladding systems and professional lighting solutions. Since 2015, we have transformed hundreds of commercial, industrial, and residential buildings across the country.
section.body2: Our HPLINE division transforms building exteriors with HPL panels, granite and seranit cladding, and Alikafon materials. A facade is more than aesthetics — it is a critical layer protecting a building from heat, moisture, and external influences.
section.body3: Our ALIF Light division designs and installs LED lighting, decorative fixtures, and emergency lighting systems. Energy-efficient, long-lasting, and visually stunning lighting solutions are our speciality.
